authorship: Experiments designed/concieved by Vijay Erramilli. Code written by Vijay Erramilli and Codex
scope: Training-split sensitivity on the existing Phase-5 data, not independent datasets or new confirmation. The historical clean-task gate failed. The 20 splits reuse the same training population; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals over independent experiments.
split: Split unordered name-pair training clusters into two disjoint halves for each seed. No prompt from a cluster occurs in both halves. Keep all calibration masks, candidate pools, held-out prompts and the controller fixed.
report: per-fit action loss at every target
